standard_target: WCAG 2.2 AA as design target; not yet tested or claimed conformant

checks.testable_expectation: At 200% text size, essential content and controls remain available without clipped text or lost actions.
At narrow mobile width, content reflows without horizontal scrolling except genuinely two-dimensional content.
Normal text and essential UI states meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast thresholds.
Status, errors and charts do not rely on colour alone.
Keyboard focus is clearly visible and not obscured by sticky UI.
All essential actions can be completed with keyboard only.
Focus order follows logical reading and task order.
Buttons, fields, icons and custom controls expose meaningful accessible names and roles.
Errors identify the field, issue and corrective action in text.
Touch targets meet WCAG 2.2 target-size minimum or documented exception; practical spacing avoids accidental taps.
Timed tasks can be paused, extended or disabled unless timing is essential to the construct.
Reduced-motion preference disables non-essential animation and parallax.
TalkBack/VoiceOver announces heading, label, state and action in a useful order.
Instructional video has accurate captions; meaningful audio information also has text alternative.
Audio-only learning material has a transcript.
Informative images have purpose-equivalent alt text; decorative images are ignored by assistive technology.
Essential instructions are not embedded only in images.
Page and passage language are programmatically identified; Bangla passages use correct language metadata.
Bangla conjuncts, vowel signs, punctuation and line wrapping render correctly on target Android devices.
Missing glyphs fall back without tofu boxes or broken shaping.
Instructions define unfamiliar terms and use one main action per step.
Glossary terms remain consistent across UI, teaching content and assessments.
Learners can use oral, written, diagrammatic or practical modes when the modality is not itself being assessed.
Alternative response modes do not remove the skill being assessed.
Core reading, attempt capture and schedule view work with images/video blocked.
Previously downloaded learning content and local capture remain usable without network.
Offline writes queue locally and sync later without duplicate or silent loss.
Conflicting edits are shown for user resolution; no silent last-write-wins for authored content/evidence.
Media is user-triggered, compressed and has a text alternative; no autoplay.
Core flows remain responsive on low/mid-range Android hardware; expensive motion is optional.
Bangla, English, numbers, formulas and code retain correct direction and order.
Equations have accessible reading alternatives and do not depend only on a raster image.
After validation failure, focus moves to or announces the error summary and affected field.
No flashing content exceeds accepted thresholds; avoid rapid flashing entirely.
Users can pause, stop, hide or disable non-essential animation, audio and auto-advance.
Charts have text summaries and data tables or equivalent descriptions.
Safety and privacy notices are concise, understandable and available in Bangla/English.
Consent, export, delete and sharing controls are discoverable and operable with assistive tech.
No punitive streak loss, public ranking by default or inaccessible urgency-only signals.
Critical flows remain understandable with low cognitive load and allow save/resume.
